valuation_reference.fx_timestamp_hkt: latest parent supplied; exact quote timestamp not independently supplied
valuation_reference.warning: Reference quote supplied by parent, refresh if needed; H1 annualization is not a 2026 forecast and adjusted profit still includes licensing milestones. No verified post-BD normalized profit denominator was disclosed.

licensing.royalties: Tiered double-digit percentage of net product sales in licensed territory. Future and contingent; not yet realized sales royalty.
licensing.2025_recognition: 2025 licensing revenue CNY9,425,908,000 primarily from upfront and option fees received. Do not equate this entire revenue with net profit.
licensing.2026h1_recognition: 2026H1 CNY851,584,000 licensing revenue explicitly attributed to milestone payments received from Pfizer for 707.
licensing.equity_warning: USD100m / HKD785m share subscription is equity financing, not license revenue or profit.
licensing.contractual_vs_realized_warning: USD4.8bn maximum milestones are not firm receivables or committed cash. USD1.4bn language may aggregate USD1.25bn upfront + up-to-USD0.15bn option/exercise; annual report does not independently certify the whole USD1.4bn as upfront collected.

findings.financial_latest: Only 2026H1 financial statements located in all 47 HKEX disclosures for 2026 through 2026-11-06; no Q3 report.
findings.currency: All financial statement monetary amounts above CNY; stock quote and market cap HKD must convert. Vendor main-indicator CURRENCY=HKD is misleading for financial values and was not used.
findings.adjusted_profit_definition: Company excludes selected share compensation, fair value movements and nonoperating FX. Licensing upfront and milestones are NOT excluded, in both FY2025 and H12026.
findings.underlying_sales: H12026 pharmaceutical revenue down19.3%; management explicitly attributes to healthcare insurance policy, VBP and VAT adjustment. Report says no material acquisitions/disposals of subsidiaries/associates/JVs in period. No identified disposal of Yisaipu explaining the decline.
findings.fx_vs_operations: Statutory profit decline includes FX loss CNY503.308m vs gain9.515m; do not attribute entire profit decline solely to product sales.
findings.normalization_warning: No audited post-tax parent-attributable licensing profit reconciliation found. Cannot subtract gross licensing revenue directly from parent profit or label management-adjusted profit as recurring ex-BD. Allocation of transaction costs, tax and minority interests required.
findings.net_cash_warning: Group gross cash/nonpledged term deposits and group debt include subsidiaries with minority shareholders. This is not an audited free distributable parent net-cash figure, and full subtraction from parent market cap as EV may overstate owners economic cash.
